nodes.title: E03: implementation
nodes.goal: Восстановить E03 как полный runtime-safe RLS contract: все существующие защищённые пути работают только в transaction-local least-privilege principal context.
scope: Wire platform-admin, identity-admin, project registry/tree, notifications, dashboard, readiness/health, outbox worker, heartbeat and retention paths to explicit authorized transactions
Add separate system-job principal that may operate only required operational rows and cannot access identity, membership or tenant data
Keep default-deny RLS, composite tenant constraints, NOBYPASSRLS runtime identities and regenerated pre-production baseline migration
Do not add production credentials, live database migration or product-specific vertical
acceptance_criteria: No reachable path accesses an E03 RLS-protected model outside an authorized transaction-local principal context.
Platform-admin, readiness/health and worker flows retain only their documented least-privilege capabilities.
System-job cannot impersonate user or platform-staff and cannot access identity or tenant-membership data.
required_checks: Protected-model access guard and exhaustive runtime adoption map review
PostgreSQL 18 integration, migration and ACL proof

required_checks: PostgreSQL 18 integration suite, migration/ACL and RLS coverage checks
Static protected-model guard plus exact diff-to-scope review
